## 5. Preprocessing & Leakage Prevention Directives
1. `isFlaggedFraud` in PaySim is strictly dropped prior to model training to prevent target leakage.
2. All scaling transforms (StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder) must fit strictly on `X_train` folds and transform `X_val` / `X_test` out-of-fold.
3. Test sets are strictly held out (80/20 stratified split) with zero SMOTE/oversampling applied to test folds.
